# Abhishek Gupta — Portfolio

> Portfolio of Abhishek Gupta, a Full Stack (MERN) developer building interactive, 3D-enhanced web experiences.

Abhishek Gupta is a Full Stack Developer specializing in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) with a focus on creative, interactive, and 3D web engineering. This site showcases his projects, skills, and contact information.
